description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'Parts' for creating multipart form data parts and handling media types for file uploads, specifically for use with HTTP APIs in the Fineract client. It includes methods to generate parts from files or byte arrays, determine media types based on file extensions, and extract filenames from HTTP responses.

classes.name: Parts
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to create multipart form data parts from files or byte arrays, determine media types based on file extensions, and extract filenames from HTTP responses.

methods.name: fromFile
methods.description: Creates a multipart form data Part from a given File object, inferring the media type based on the file extension.

methods.name: fromBytes
methods.description: Creates a multipart form data Part from a byte array and filename, inferring the media type based on the filename extension.

methods.name: mediaType
methods.description: Determines the MediaType based on the file extension of the provided filename.

methods.name: fileName
methods.description: Extracts the filename from the Content-Disposition header of an HTTP response, if present.
